config.acknowledged_omission: inertial and centrifugal contributions to F_app neglected (quasi-static piston force)
config.analysis_convention: Binding splits conditional on convergence; non-convergence (blow-up) fraction reported alongside in every table; blow-up treated as the limiting case of film failure, not missing data; infrastructure error rows excluded from all label statistics and reported separately.

input_space.name: omega
input_space.note: rated envelope; pre-freeze extension 470 -> 475 carried from box A

input_space.name: p_ch
input_space.note: NOW SETS THE LOAD: F_app = p_ch * A_p.  Floor raised 2.0e5 -> 2.0e6 (20 bar): this is a CLOSED-CIRCUIT pump, so the chamber never sees 2 bar -- during suction the low-pressure side is held at charge/boost pressure (~20-30 bar), and a 2 bar floor samples states the machine does not occupy.  Scale log -> LINEAR: load enters the constraints through the linearly-acting F_app = p_ch*A_p on a bounded envelope, so uniform coverage in p_ch is the natural choice; log scaling earns its place for order-of-magnitude parameters with multiplicative response (eta_0, lambda), which this is not

input_space.name: T_in
input_space.note: per-fluid-class g2 ceilings still cap water-glycol

input_space.name: eta_0
input_space.note: pre-freeze extension carried from box A; strict SUPERSET of the slipper axis -- see COMMON_SUBBOX_WITH_SLIPPER

input_space.name: theta_min_deg
input_space.note: feed-pocket edge; the physical control on the relief fraction beta = A_pocket/A_p.  Widened from the representative [25, 36] because it is now a design axis, not a geometric uncertainty

config.load_model: F_app = p_ch * A_p (coupled); F_pocket = p_ch * A_pocket; F_hyd > 0 by construction
